summary: Worded the one fixed line of the v0.1.0 entry (#1: the new sub function in src/sub.js) and kept the version at v0.1.0, since nothing is breaking. I ask orus to open a release pull request titled "Release v0.1.0" with the changelog file.

actions.title: Release v0.1.0
actions.body:
First release of the repository, v0.1.0.

The release adds `sub(a, b)` in `src/sub.js`, which returns `a - b` (#1). Nothing in this release breaks an existing use.

Orus closes #1 after this pull request is merged.
